plunk: Plunk the block into the bucket!
把积木咚地一声丢进水桶里！
The frog made a plunk noise in the pond.
青蛙在池塘里发出扑通一声。
Did you hear the plunk of the ball?
你听到球扑通一声了吗？
polite: The polite kid says thank you every day.
这个有礼貌的孩子每天都道谢。
Is it polite to laugh at your friend?
笑话自己的朋友有礼貌吗？
pollution: Cars make a lot of pollution in the city.
汽车在城市里制造了很多污染。
Is pollution bad for the fish in the river?
污染对小河里的鱼有害吗？
Let's stop pollution and keep our river clean!
我们一起减少污染，让小河干干净净吧！
poor: The poor little mouse was cold in the rain.
可怜的小老鼠在雨里冷坏了。
Why does the poor farmer work all day?
可怜的农民为什么要干一整天活呀？
You poor thing, come inside and get warm!
你这个小可怜，快进来暖暖身子！
popular: The panda is a popular animal in the park.
熊猫是公园里最受欢迎的动物。
What is the most popular game at school?
学校里最流行的游戏是什么？
Soccer is so popular in our city!
足球在我们城市特别流行！
porridge: My porridge is too hot to eat now.
我的粥现在太烫了，还喝不了。
Do you like porridge with milk and jam?
你喜欢加了牛奶和果酱的粥吗？
Eat your porridge now, or it will be cold!
快把粥喝了，不然就凉啦！
port: The big boat comes into the port at night.
Is the port near the old lighthouse?
Wow, so many boats are in the port today!
哇，今天港口里有好多船呀！
possibility: There is a small possibility of rain today.
今天有一点点可能下雨。
Is there any possibility that school is closed tomorrow?
明天有没有可能不上学呀？
Every day has a new possibility!
postcard: My grandmother gave me a postcard from the beach.
奶奶送给我一张海边寄来的明信片。
Did you see the postcard in the mailbox?
你看到信箱里的明信片了吗？
Let's write a postcard to our friend!
我们给朋友写张明信片吧！
pounce: The cat will pounce on the little red ball.
小猫会扑向那个红色的小球。
Did you see the fox pounce in the snow?
你看见狐狸在雪地里扑食了吗？
Watch the owl pounce on the mouse!
pray: The family will pray together at night.
一家人晚上会一起祈祷。
Why do people pray with their eyes closed?
人们祈祷时为什么要闭上眼睛呢？
Let's pray for our family and friends!
我们为家人和朋友祈祷吧！
precipitation: Rain and snow are precipitation from the sky.
雨和雪都是天上落下来的降水。
What precipitation do we see in winter?
冬天我们能见到哪种降水呀？
What a lot of precipitation we had today!
predator: A predator is an animal that eats other animals.
捕食者就是吃其他动物的动物。
Is the big fish a predator of small fish?
大鱼是小鱼的捕食者吗？
Run, little bug, the predator is coming!
快跑呀小虫子，捕食者来了！
prejudice: The story tells us prejudice is bad.
这个故事告诉我们，偏见是不对的。
Why was there prejudice in the old book?
为什么那本旧书里会有偏见呢？
Let's stop prejudice and be good friends!
我们别再有偏见，好好做朋友吧！
preserved: Ice preserved the old animals for a long time.
冰雪把古老的动物保存了很久很久。
Was the fruit preserved in the cold fridge?
水果是放在冰箱里保鲜的吗？
The old seeds were preserved in the sand!
古老的种子被完好地保存在沙子里啦！
prickles: Watch out, the plant has prickles!
The green plant has little prickles on its leaves.
绿绿的植物叶子上长着小尖刺。
Does the fish have prickles on its back?
primate: A monkey is a primate that lives in trees.
猴子是一种住在树上的灵长类动物。
Which primate is the biggest animal in the jungle?
丛林里最大的灵长类动物是哪一种呀？
Look, the baby primate hangs onto its mother!
快看，灵长类宝宝紧紧抓着妈妈呢！
prime minister: The prime minister works in a big building.
首相在一栋大楼里办公。
Wow, the prime minister is coming to our city!
哇，首相要来我们城市啦！
prince: The story is about a prince and a fairy.
这个故事是关于一位王子和一位仙女的。
Does the prince help the people in the story?
故事里的王子会帮助大家吗？
Look, a frog turned into a prince!
professional: Her father plays professional soccer on a big team.
她的爸爸在一支大球队里踢职业足球。
Do you want to be a professional pilot?
你想成为一名职业飞行员吗？
他游泳像专业选手一样棒！
professor: The professor works at the big school.
教授在一所很大的学校里工作。
Did the professor tell us about dinosaurs?
教授给我们讲恐龙的知识了吗？
The professor knows so much about birds!
教授懂好多鸟类的知识呀！
project: My art project is a paper dinosaur.
我的美术作业是一只纸恐龙。
Can we work on our project together?
我们可以一起做这个作业吗？
What a big project you made!
你做的这个作业可真大呀！
pronounce: Can you pronounce this long word?
你能读出这个长长的单词吗？
She can pronounce the hard word very well.
这个很难的单词她读得特别好。
Listen to me, then pronounce the word!
先听我读，然后你来读这个单词！
propeller: The airplane propeller goes round and round.
Does the propeller turn fast in the air?
螺旋桨在空中转得飞快吗？
Wow, the propeller makes the boat go fast!
哇，螺旋桨让小船跑得好快！
protection: A helmet gives your head good protection.
头盔能好好保护你的头。
Is a raincoat good protection from the rain?
The old tree is protection for the small animals!
这棵老树是小动物们的保护伞呀！
protest: They protest so all kids can go to school.
他们抗议，是为了让所有孩子都能上学。
Why do the people protest in the street?
人们为什么要在街上抗议呢？
Many people were together at the big protest!
好多人都一起参加了这场大抗议！
prune: The prune is a small dried fruit.
西梅干是一种小小的果干。
Do you want a prune with your lunch?
午饭要不要来一颗西梅干呀？
This prune is small, but it is very yummy!
这颗西梅干小小的，可是特别好吃！
pterodactyl: The pterodactyl flies over the big trees.
Did the pterodactyl have wings like a bat?
翼龙的翅膀长得像蝙蝠吗？
Wow, the pterodactyl has a very long beak!
哇，这只翼龙的嘴又尖又长呀！
puck: The black puck slides on the ice.
黑色的冰球在冰面上滑来滑去。
The puck is small, hard, and round!
冰球小小的、硬硬的、圆圆的！
puffin: The puffin has a black and white body.
Can the puffin swim under the cold water?
海鹦能在冰冷的水下游泳吗？
Look at the little puffin with the colorful beak!
快看那只嘴巴五颜六色的小海鹦！
pulley: The pulley helps the worker with the big box.
How does the pulley take the bucket up?
滑轮是怎么把水桶拉上来的？
The pulley made the hard work so easy!
有了滑轮，重活变得好轻松呀！
pulp: Orange pulp is inside the fruit.
橙子的果肉就在果实里面。
Do you like pulp in your orange drink?
你喜欢橙子饮料里有果肉吗？
The old paper is made into new pulp!
旧纸被做成了新的纸浆！
punish: School will not punish you for a bad day.
就算你一天表现不好，学校也不会罚你。
Why punish the dog when the fence was open?
栅栏本来就开着，为什么要罚小狗呀？
punt: He will punt the football far down the field.
他会把橄榄球踢到球场很远的地方。
Can you punt the ball over the fence?
What a long punt at the game!
比赛里这一脚踢得真远呀！
racism: We read about racism in our old book.
我们在一本旧书里读到了种族歧视的故事。
Why do we say no to racism?
我们为什么要对种族歧视说不呢？
Stop racism so all people can be together!
反对种族歧视，让大家都能亲亲密密在一起！
radiation: The sun gives us light and radiation every day.
太阳每天给我们送来光和辐射。
Do the workers need suits near radiation?
工人在有辐射的地方要穿防护服吗？
The sun's radiation helps the plants live!
太阳的辐射能帮助植物生长呢！
rage: Do not let rage make you say bad words.
别让怒气让你说出不好听的话。
What do you do when rage comes?
怒气上来的时候，你会怎么做呀？
The bull rages and runs at the red cape!
公牛发怒了，朝着红斗篷冲过去！
ranch: The cows eat grass on the big ranch.
Does the ranch have horses and sheep?
What a lot of work on a ranch!
牧场上的活儿可真多呀！
range: The river starts high in the range.
这条河从高高的山脉里流出来。
Can you see the white range from the plane?
从飞机上能看到白雪覆盖的山脉吗？
How tall the old range looks at sunset!
日落时分的古老山脉显得多高呀！
rapids: The boat goes fast down the rapids.
Can the little fish swim up the rapids?
小鱼能逆着急流游上去吗？
Wow, the rapids make a big noise!
raptor: The owl is a night raptor with big eyes.
猫头鹰是长着大眼睛的夜间猛禽。
Is the eagle a raptor of the high cliffs?
老鹰是住在高高悬崖上的猛禽吗？
Watch the raptor fly down to the river!
rare: The blue egg is very rare.
这颗蓝色的蛋非常少见。
Is this flower rare in our city?
这种花在我们城市里很少见吗？
Wow, we found a rare white butterfly!
哇，我们发现了一只罕见的白蝴蝶！
ray: The big ray swims with its wide wings.
大鳐鱼摆着宽宽的鳍游泳。
Does the ray sleep under the sand?
鳐鱼会藏在沙子底下睡觉吗？
Look at the ray jump out of the water!
recognize: I recognize my friend by her red hat.
我靠那顶红帽子认出了我的朋友。
Do you recognize this song from the movie?
你听出这是电影里的歌了吗？
Wow, I recognize that bird from the book!
哇，我认出这是书里的那只鸟啦！
record: Please record the birds you see in your book.
请把你看到的鸟记在本子上。
Did you record how many birds you saw?
你记下自己看到了多少只鸟吗？
That was a new record for our team!
那是我们队的一项新纪录！
reflect: The lake will reflect the tall trees.
湖面会映出高高的大树。
Does the wet street reflect the sun?
湿湿的街道会反照阳光吗？
Look how the bubbles reflect the rainbow!
reflection: I see my reflection in the window.
我在窗户上看到了自己的影子。
Can you see your reflection in the water?
你能在水里看见自己的倒影吗？
What a big reflection in the spoon!
refreshed: The cold water made me feel refreshed.
凉水让我一下子精神起来。
Do you feel refreshed when you wake up?
你醒来的时候觉得精神满满吗？
A short nap made her feel so refreshed!
睡了个小觉，她感觉精神极了！
regurgitate: Some birds regurgitate food for their babies.
有些鸟会把食物反吐出来喂宝宝。
Do owls regurgitate what they cannot eat?
猫头鹰会把消化不了的东西吐出来吗？
Wow, the big frog can regurgitate its meal!
哇，大青蛙竟然能把吃下去的东西吐出来！
rehearsal: We have a rehearsal for the school play.
我们要给学校演出排练啦。
Where is the rehearsal for our song?
我们排练歌曲的地方在哪儿呀？
The dance rehearsal was so much fun!
relative: Every relative was at our big family lunch.
家庭大聚餐上，亲戚们全都来了。
Which relative gave you this gift?
这份礼物是哪位亲戚送给你的？
A new relative is coming to our house!
有位亲戚要来我们家啦！
relay: Our team runs a relay in the big field.
我们队在大操场上跑接力赛。
Do you want to be in the relay?
Yay, our relay team is so fast!
耶，我们的接力队跑得好快呀！
religion: People of many religions live in our city.
我们城市里住着信奉不同宗教的人。
What do you know about religion?
关于宗教你知道些什么呀？
Books can tell us about every religion!
书本能告诉我们各种宗教的知识！
remember: I remember the day we got our dog.
我还记得抱小狗回家的那一天。
Do you remember the words to this song?
你还记得这首歌的词儿吗？
Remember to close the door at night!
repel: The raincoat can repel the rain.
Does the umbrella repel the rain too?
How the duck's feathers repel the water!
鸭子的羽毛一点儿都不沾水！
replica: The little replica boat sits on my desk.
小小的船模摆在我的书桌上。
Is this replica made of paper?
Wow, the dinosaur replica looks so tall!
哇，恐龙模型看起来好高呀！
reptile: A snake is a reptile with no legs.
蛇是一种没有腿的爬行动物。
Is the crocodile the biggest reptile in the river?
鳄鱼是河里最大的爬行动物吗？
Look at that little reptile in the sun!
快看晒太阳的那只小爬行动物！
rescue: The rescue team found the little cat.
救援队找到了那只小猫。
Who will rescue the cat in the tall tree?
谁来救救困在高高树上的小猫呀？
What a big rescue at the beach today!
今天海滩上的大营救真了不起！
research: She does research on bees at the library.
她在图书馆里做关于蜜蜂的研究。
Did you do research about the big whale?
你做了关于大鲸鱼的调查吗？
Good research takes a lot of time!
做好一项研究要花好多时间呢！
resolution: My resolution is to read more books.
我的决心是多读一些书。
Did you keep your resolution for ten days?
你的决心坚持了十天吗？
Helping at home is her good resolution!
在家帮忙干活是她的好决心！
resource: Water is a resource we use every day.
水是我们每天都要用的资源。
Is the forest a resource for the animals?
森林是动物们的一种资源吗？
Books are a good resource for kids at school!
书是孩子们在学校里的好资源！
responsibility: Walking the dog is my responsibility.
Is cleaning your room your responsibility?
打扫自己的房间是你的责任吗？
What a big responsibility for a small kid!
对小孩子来说这责任可真大呀！
revolution: The wheel makes one revolution when you turn it.
你一转，轮子就转上一整圈。
How many revolutions can you do in one turn?
你一次能转多少个整圈呀？
He makes a fast revolution when he dances!
他跳舞转圈的时候转得飞快！
roam: The horses roam the big plains all day.
马儿们一整天在大草原上溜达。
Where do the deer roam at night?
晚上鹿儿们会去哪里闲逛呢？
What fun to roam the green forest!
在绿绿的森林里到处走走多好玩呀！
roti: Mother makes warm roti for lunch.
妈妈午饭做了热乎乎的印度薄饼。
Do you eat roti with your meal?
你吃饭的时候会配印度薄饼吗？
What a big roti your mother made!
你妈妈做的薄饼好大呀！
route: The bus takes a new route today.
公交车今天走了一条新路线。
Which route is the shortest way to school?
走哪条路线去学校最近呀？
I love this route by the blue lake!
我好喜欢沿着蓝色湖泊走的这条路！
runt: The runt of the pig family is very small.
一窝小猪里最小的那只特别小。
Why is the runt so small?
这只小不点为什么这么小呀？
The little runt drinks milk from its mother!
小不点正凑在妈妈身边喝奶呢！
rush: Do not rush when you eat your lunch.
吃午饭的时候不要急急忙忙的。
Why do you always rush to school?
你为什么总是急匆匆赶去学校呀？
Water rushes down the big rocks!
河水从大石头上哗哗冲下来！
sac: The seed is inside a small green sac.
种子藏在一个绿色的小囊里。
Is the sac big or little?
这个小囊是大还是小呀？
Look at the round sac on the green leaf!
快看绿叶上圆圆的小囊！
saddle: Put the saddle on the horse's back.
Is the saddle too big for the small horse?
这个马鞍对小马来说太大了吗？
What a fine new saddle for your horse!
给你家马儿配的新马鞍真漂亮！
saint: People tell stories about a good saint.
人们讲述着一位好心圣人的故事。
Did the saint help people in the old story?
在古老的故事里，圣人帮助过大家吗？
How the people love their good saint!
人们多么爱戴他们的好圣人呀！
saliva: Saliva helps animals eat their food.
唾液能帮助动物吃东西。
Does your body make saliva all day?
你的身体一整天都会分泌唾液吗？
Wow, the dog's saliva is all over the window!
哇，狗狗的口水蹭得满窗户都是！
salute: The pilot gives us a salute from the plane.
飞行员在飞机上向我们敬礼。
Do you salute your friend when the game starts?
游戏开始的时候你会向朋友敬个礼吗？
sank: The little boat sank in the cold lake.
小船沉进了冰凉的湖水里。
Did you see how the toy boat sank?
你看见玩具小船是怎么沉下去的吗？
Oh no, my toy sank in the bucket!
哎呀，我的玩具掉进水桶里沉下去啦！
sap: The sap comes out of the old tree.
树液从老树里流了出来。
Oops, the sap sticks to my glove!
哎呀，树液粘在我的手套上啦！
scalp: The shampoo cleans your scalp very well.
洗发水能把头皮洗得干干净净。
Is your scalp wet when you take a bath?
你洗澡的时候头皮会湿吗？
Oh no, a little bug is on my scalp!
哎呀，一只小虫子爬到我头皮上了！
scaly: A snake is long and scaly.
Does the lizard feel scaly and dry?
蜥蜴摸起来是不是又干又糙的呀？
What a big scaly crocodile in the river!
河里那条鳄鱼满身鳞甲，个头好大呀！
scenery: I love the scenery from the fast train.
我喜欢从飞驰的火车里看风景。
What scenery can you see from the window?
从窗口你能看到哪些风景呀？
The scenery here is so green and nice!
scold: Grandmother never scolds and always smiles.
奶奶从来不骂人，总是笑眯眯的。
Why did the mother scold the little cat?
妈妈为什么要说小猫几句呀？
Please do not scold him for the wet shoes!
鞋子湿了，请别说他的不是呀！
scooter: I go fast on my new scooter.
我踩着新滑板车嗖嗖地跑。
Is your scooter fast or slow?
你的滑板车是快还是慢呀？
Take your scooter to the park!
带上你的滑板车去公园吧！
screw: The old chair needs one more screw.
这把旧椅子还差一颗螺丝。
Where did the little screw go?
Use this tool to turn the screw!
用这个工具把螺丝拧一拧！
sculpture: My sculpture of a horse is made of paper.
我的小马雕塑是用纸做的。
Did you make that sculpture in art today?
今天美术课你做了那个雕塑吗？
What a tall sculpture in the city park!
城市公园里的雕塑好高呀！
seahorse: The seahorse swims near the tall seaweed.
海马在高高的海草旁边游来游去。
Does the father seahorse keep the babies?
海马爸爸会照看海马宝宝吗？
Wow, the little seahorse looks like a horse!
哇，小海马看起来真像一匹小马！
segregated: In the old days, some schools were segregated.
在过去，有些学校是隔离分开的。
Was the old bus segregated back then?
那时候的公交车也是分开坐的吗？
Now all schools are together, never segregated!
现在所有学校都在一起，再也不隔离啦！
sensitive: My little sister is sensitive to the cold.
Is the cat sensitive to noise at night?
小猫晚上听到声响会很敏感吗？
Don't cry, my sensitive little friend!
别哭啦，我敏感又贴心的小朋友！
settle: Let's settle down and read a book.
我们安顿下来看会儿书吧！
Did the butterfly settle on the flower?
The baby settled in her bed and slept!
小宝宝在床上安安稳稳地睡着啦！
settler: The settler made a small house near the river.
拓荒者在小河边盖了一座小房子。
What did the settlers eat in the cold winter?
寒冷的冬天，拓荒者们吃什么呢？
拓荒者们干活多么辛苦呀！
shame: What a shame that the picnic got wet!
野餐被淋湿了，真遗憾呀！
Is it bad to make a friend feel shame?
让朋友难为情是不是不好呀？
The kid hung his head in shame.
sheepdog: Look at the sheepdog with all the sheep!
快看那只和羊群在一起的牧羊犬！
Is the sheepdog a good helper for the farmer?
牧羊犬是农民的好帮手吗？

这么大的工地上有好多卡车呀！
